# Third-party notices

<!-- Generated by `yarn notices` (scripts/third-party-notices.mjs). Do not edit by hand. Generated from yarn.lock 2a0cb8359de03ef7, Cargo.lock 406139c246a75e43 -->

Nerla is released under the MIT licence. It is built on the open source software listed here. This file ships with every website build (as `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` next to `index.html`) and with the desktop app. Keep it with any copy of Nerla you distribute.

The website section lists every package in the website's production dependency tree. The desktop app wraps the same website build, and the desktop section lists every Rust crate it links on Windows, macOS and Linux. Where a package offers a choice of licences, the column `Used under` shows the one Nerla takes. Each package's full licence text is under [Licence texts](#licence-texts), one copy per distinct text with every package's copyright lines above it.

The server's licences are in `server/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md`.

## LiveKit

Nerla's calls are built on the LiveKit client libraries, and the server mints call tokens with the LiveKit server SDK. They are licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0, and are used without modification. The packages are made by LiveKit, Inc. Keep their licence texts, and this notice, with any copy of Nerla you distribute.

## Fonts

The interface fonts come from Fontsource packages and are listed in the package table with their licence texts: Figtree, Atkinson Hyperlegible and JetBrains Mono (all SIL Open Font License 1.1). They are served unmodified.

Boards use the fonts that ship inside `@excalidraw/excalidraw` in `dist/prod/fonts`. Every family Nerla serves is listed below (Liberation ships in the package but Nerla doesn't serve it), with the copyright and licence read from the font files themselves. The fonts are used unmodified, are never sold on their own, and keep their names.

## Icons, images and sounds

Icons come from Phosphor Icons (`@phosphor-icons/react`, MIT), listed below. The cat logo, the app icons, the favicon and the illustrations are Nerla's own. Nerla ships no third-party images or sounds.

## Not in the build

These are used but not shipped with Nerla.

- On Windows the desktop app runs in the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime, which Windows provides under Microsoft's own terms. It is not part of the Nerla installer.

`@excalidraw/excalidraw` builds these into its own files as WebAssembly. Their licence comments are reproduced as Excalidraw ships them.
